body.name: Simultaneous component-effect confidence collection
body.construction: For every \(n\in\mathbb N\), first select \(\widehat C_n\) by \(\texttt{def:global-bic}\). On \(S_n\in\mathbb S^p_{++}\), order the finite member-labelled coordinates \(g_E(S_n)\) for \(E\in\mathcal R(\widehat C_n)\), compute every \(L_E(S_n)\) through the block-design Gram system in \(\texttt{def:off-model-block-ls}\), and evaluate the derivative \(\mathrm Dg_E(S_n)\) of the rational map in \(\texttt{def:component-effect-set}\) only on this open positive-definite domain. Use these derivatives with the plug-in Gaussian sample-covariance covariance matrix to obtain delta-method standard errors. Let \(K\) be the number of nonconstant labelled coordinates. If \(K\geq1\), use critical value \(z_{1-\alpha/(2K)}\) for those coordinates and report structurally zero coordinates as singleton intervals; if \(K=0\), report only the singleton intervals and do not evaluate a critical value. On \(S_n\notin\mathbb S^p_{++}\), invoke no Gram inverse, coefficient map, or delta-method derivative and assign the interval \(\mathbb R\) to every member-labelled coordinate. The resulting total measurable collection is \(\mathfrak I_{n,\alpha}(\widehat C_n)\).
